name: How long does a typical living room lighting upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical living room lighting upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a living room lighting upgrade project depends on its complexity. A simple replacement of existing fixtures might take only a day. However, if the project involves installing new recessed lighting, running new electrical lines, adding or relocating switches, or upgrading the electrical panel, it could extend to several days or even a week. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project requirements during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies: simple replacements take a day, while extensive upgrades involving new wiring or fixtures can take several days to a week.
